newsitem.title: PERU: Rebels release another hostage in Peru.
newsitem.headline: Rebels release another hostage in Peru.

text.p: Marxist rebels released another hostage Wednesday afternoon from the besieged Japanese embassy residence in Peru, live television pictures showed.
Looking sick, with his head slumped to one side, the hostage was pushed out of the residence just after 5 p.m. local time (2200 GMT) in a wheelchair by Red Cross workers.
As the freed hostage waited in the street, an ambulance crossed police lines to pick him up.
There was no immediate clue as to the released hostage's identity or the reason for his release. Local media speculated that he might have been let out for health reasons.
